strategy.offer: Road transport equipment for passenger cars, plus accessories, spare parts, documentation, warranty handling, and after-sales service through workshops and support channels.
strategy.customers: Private users, professional users, dealers, and retail channels needing reliable transport solutions for varied hauling tasks.
strategy.why_we_win: The firm emphasizes quality, reliability, fairness, safety, continual product improvement, and short delivery times enabled by efficient production and distribution.
strategy.resources: Its basis is skilled employees, production know-how, training, responsibility, efficient production logistics, and a nationwide service and transport network.
strategy.direction: It aims for sustainable profitable growth, broader international expansion, and ongoing adaptation of products and structures to changing market needs.
